class.name: MaszynaTranslationServer
class.brief_description: The one catalogue [TranslationServer] translates with: the wrapper's strings and the game's own.
class.description: In the language of [member SimulationServer.language], merges the wrapper's own [code].po[/code] files (project setting [code]maszyna/locale/translations[/code]) and, over them, the game's [code]<game_dir>/lang/<language>.po[/code] - the original engine's [code]locale[/code] (translation.cpp) - into a single [Translation], so the game's translation of a msgid wins. It is rebuilt on start, whenever the language changes and whenever the game directory changes. The merged catalogue is the only translation in [TranslationServer]: every [Control], [method Object.tr] and [method Node.atr] looks up through it, and the scene tree re-translates itself on every rebuild.

method.name: translation_get_languages
method.description: The languages there is a catalogue for in the game's [code]lang/[/code] ([code]template.po[/code] excepted), with [code]"en"[/code] - the untranslated strings - always first.

method.name: translation_load
method.description: Replaces the game's catalogue with the one in [param po_path] and rebuilds the merged catalogue. Without such a file only the wrapper's own strings are translated.

signal.name: translation_languages_changed
signal.description: The game's data was read again (another game directory): [method translation_get_languages] lists the languages it has now.
